text: DSH Session Enhance 是面向 DSH Web 的会话管理增强插件，通过替换工作区、投影缓存和界面服务，扩展会话侧栏与管理页面。它支持归档和恢复会话、预览归档对话、删除会话并清理本机记录、在工作区间拖动会话，以及查看和切换对话分支；还提供后台会话通知、会话 ID 复制和记录同步。适合需要整理大量 DSH Web 对话、清理旧会话或从不同分支继续工作的用户。无需额外 API Key 或外部账号；可在设置中调整 DSH 家目录和通知开关。

DSH Session Enhance adds session tools to DSH Web: archive and restore chats, preview or delete sessions, move them between workspaces, and explore conversation branches. It also offers notifications and record synchronization. No API key or external account is required.

怎样彻底删除会话并清掉本地残留记录？

想查看同一段对话的不同回答分支并切换。
后台会话需要我处理或结束时，能给我桌面提示吗？
怎么快速复制一个会话的 ID？
DSH 侧栏里的会话记录和磁盘文件对不上时，如何重新同步？
DSH Session Enhance 的功能「归档与恢复」：把暂时不用的会话从常用列表收起，之后可恢复；界面支持逐条和按范围批量恢复。
DSH Session Enhance 的功能「物理删除」：删除会话时处理运行中的会话并清除转录目录和相关索引记录；操作结束会验证删除结果。
DSH Session Enhance 的功能「跨工作区移动」：将会话归属移动到另一工作区，客户端可通过拖动发起，宿主处理归属和投影更新。
DSH Session Enhance 的功能「归档预览」：以只读方式获取会话内容，适合检查归档对话后再决定是否恢复。
DSH Session Enhance 的功能「对话分支」：读取分支树并切换或重新生成分支，让用户从较早轮次继续探索对话。
DSH Session Enhance 会在本机 DSH 家目录的会话、存储和附件目录读写数据；删除操作会清理对应记录，家目录默认为 ~/.dsh。

dsh-session-enhance README · ⚡ DSH Session Enhance：**Conversation enhancement for DeepSeek Harness Web.** Manage sessions like a real tool, not a list of JSON files: archive and restore chats, guarantee physical deletion, drag sessions between workspaces, branch any conversation and switch freely, and get notified the moment a background conversation needs you.

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

---

dsh-session-enhance README · What it is：`dsh-session-enhance` is a conversation-enhance plugin for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web**. It exists to make every conversation in DSH easier to find, organise, clean up and come back to — so you spend less time wrestling the session list and more time talking.

dsh-session-enhance README · What it is：At its core it treats the session list as a *view over the files on disk*, not as an authority of its own. Every operation below is a real, verified filesystem change — with rollback on failure — so the sidebar and the transcripts can never silently disagree again. Deleting a chat removes its files for good; dragging a chat between workspaces actually relocates its transcript; switching branches happens inside the same conversation without losing a single reply.

dsh-session-enhance README · 🗂️ Archive & restore：Archive any conversation from the session menu; archived rows get a clear badge and stay out of the way until you need them, then unarchive in one click. Archive state is orthogonal to workspace membership, so an archived chat keeps its place.

dsh-session-enhance README · 🗂️ Archive & restore：- Archive / unarchive per session, from the sidebar menu.
- **Archive Manager** (设置 → 对话增强 → 归档管理): search, sort by last-updated / created / name, filter by project, restore one / batch-restore (all, per project, or ungrouped).
- **Preview chat** — open any archived conversation read-only: turn-by-turn user / assistant / system view, tool calls and results, Markdown and inlined images.

dsh-session-enhance README · 🗑️ Guaranteed physical delete：- Flushes and detaches a running session, then releases the agent that still holds it.
- Removes the transcript directory (with retries for Windows handle release) and cascades to its subagent children.
- Sweeps every trace of the session out of `~/storages/*.json`, the projection cache, the archive set and the workspace records.
- Verifies after deletion that nothing is left — and, if anything is, tells you.
- Tombstones the deleted id so a stale session list can never resurrect a ghost; a same-id *new* conversation is still recognised correctly.

dsh-session-enhance README · 🗑️ Guaranteed physical delete：Deletion confirmations spell out exactly what will be lost (conversation, child agents including running ones, caches). Delete a single session, or batch-delete every archived chat — all, one project, or the ungrouped set.

dsh-session-enhance README · 📦 Move between workspaces — by drag：Drag a session row onto another workspace group and its transcript **physically moves** to that project's folder. The session file's `cwd` header is rewritten (zstd-aware: header stays its own frame, layout is verified, rollback on any failure), the projection cache is re-homed so the title survives, and stale agents are released. If the dragged chat is the one you have open, it reopens automatically and stays usable. Moving to *Ungrouped* simply unassigns it. Reorder chats inside a workspace by dragging too.

dsh-session-enhance README · 🔔 Conversation notifications：Run a conversation, switch away — when it **finishes** or when it **needs your input** (approval, plan review, a question), a system notification pops up while the page isn't focused. Enable/disable under 基础设置.
dsh-session-enhance README · 📋 Copy session ID：One click in the session menu — works on archived sessions too.

dsh-session-enhance README · 🌳 Conversation tree：Every conversation is a **tree, not a line**. Each of your turns is a node; whenever you regenerate or edit an answer, a *new branch* forks off — the old replies are kept, not thrown away, and you can switch back at any time.

dsh-session-enhance README · 🌳 Conversation tree：- A tree overview draws along the conversation: colour-coded branches, dots for each turn, lines that connect them; hover a dot to inspect a turn, click it to jump there.
- **Regenerate** — at any finished reply, rewind and regenerate from that turn (a "重新生成" button under the answer).
- **Edit & regenerate** — open any of your previous messages, change it, and let DSH continue from the new wording.
- **Switch branches** — at any fork point use the `‹ n/m ›` control to flip between alternate continuations of the same conversation.
- Safe by construction: if a deeper branch would be rewritten, the dangerous action is refused (and the button hidden) rather than risking orphaned content. Branch operations issued while an answer is still streaming are queued and replayed automatically when it finishes.

dsh-session-enhance README · 🔁 Records sync & self-healing：Because the session index can drift after manual edits or another DSH instance writing files:

- **同步记录** reconciles the stored records against the real transcripts: ghost entries purged, mis-assigned sessions moved to their real project, missing sessions re-accounted, projection-cache ghosts removed and identities re-homed.
- On startup the plugin re-aligns moved sessions' cached identities to their physical headers, so titles don't degrade to a workspace name after a restart.

dsh-session-enhance README · 🧹 Workspace & disk hygiene：- Manage workspaces from the sidebar: create one by picking an existing folder, rename, delete (sessions fall back to *Ungrouped*, files kept), and add a session inside a project.
- In the Archive Manager, deleting a project also removes its archived chats and, once empty, its on-disk folder.
- Empty workspace directories left behind on disk are listed and deletable.

dsh-session-enhance README · ⚙️ Settings：**设置 → 对话增强** has two tabs:
- **基础设置** — the `.dsh` home directory the plugin reads `storages` / `sessions` / `attachments` from (default `~/.dsh`, pick a folder or restore default), and the **对话通知** toggle.
- **归档管理** — everything described under archive above.

dsh-session-enhance README · Screenshots：Basic settings under 设置 → 对话增强 → 基础设置.

Manage archived chats under 设置 → 对话增强 → 归档管理: search, sort, filter by project, 同步记录, restore and delete.

Preview archived chats under 设置 → 对话增强 → 归档管理.

Session actions in the workspace sidebar (archive, copy ID, delete, …).

dsh-session-enhance README · Screenshots：The conversation tree of a branched session: every turn is a colour-coded node on the left rail, each finished answer can be **重新生成** (regenerate), any of your earlier messages can be **修改** (edited and regenerated), and at a fork point the `‹ n/m ›` control switches between alternate continuations of the same conversation.

Notification when a background conversation finishes.

dsh-session-enhance README · Install：Requires a working DeepSeek Harness **Web** setup (`dsh` on PATH, `web` profile initialised) and Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.

```powershell
dsh-session-enhance README · From GitHub (latest commit)：dsh plugin --profile web add github:Tinger-X/dsh-session-enhance
dsh-session-enhance README · From npm (stable release)：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-enhance

dsh-session-enhance README · From source (development)：git clone https://github.com/Tinger-X/dsh-session-enhance.git
cd dsh-session-enhance; pnpm install
dsh plugin --profile web add .

dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

Restart DSH Web and hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5). The **对话增强** entry appears in Settings.

> Conversation-tree capabilities track the development branch. If you install the npm stable build and don't see the tree, update to the latest commit above.

dsh-session-enhance README · Quick start：- **Browse** — search, group by workspace (or a single list), sort by recency or manually, spot live status on each row.
- **Archive** — session menu → *Archive*; manage later in 设置 → 对话增强 → 归档管理.
- **Preview** — eye icon on an archived chat.
- **Delete** — session menu → *Delete session* (always confirmed). Batch: 归档管理 → per-group *Delete all*.
- **Move** — drag a session row onto another workspace group; drag to reorder inside a workspace.
- **Copy ID** — session menu → *Copy ID*.
- **Notify** — start a conversation and switch away.
- **Branch** — open a conversation: use *重新生成* under an answer or the edit button on one of your messages to fork a branch, and `‹ ›` at a fork point to switch.

dsh-session-enhance README · Roadmap：- Open a workspace folder on disk.
- Scheduled archiving — automatically archive conversations that have been idle for a while.
- Batch archive / delete across the workspace, straight from the session list.
- Star conversations — pin them to the top of their workspace and exempt them from auto-archive.
- Conversation sharing — export / import a conversation tree (`.dshse-share`) and keep talking on the imported copy.
- Delete individual tree nodes / branches.
- Deeper conversation-tree controls, performance and stability.
- Conversation rollback that rewinds files changed mid-turn.
- More session ergonomics as they come up.

dsh-session-enhance README · ⚡ DSH Session Enhance：**面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的对话增强插件。** 让会话管理真正像工具而非一摞 JSON 文件：归档与恢复对话、保证物理删除、跨工作区拖拽会话、把任意对话变成可自由切换分支的树，以及后台对话需要你时第一时间通知你。

[English](README.md)

---

dsh-session-enhance README · 这是什么：`dsh-session-enhance` 是针对 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web** 的对话增强插件，致力于让每一次对话都更易于查找、整理、清理与回访——少花时间折腾会话列表，多花时间对话。

它的核心思路是把会话列表当成**磁盘文件之上的一个视图**，而不是独立的权威：下面每一项操作都是真实、经过校验的文件系统变更——失败自动回滚——侧栏与转录文件从此不会再悄悄对不上账。删除对话会真正抹掉它的文件；把对话拖到另一个工作区会真的搬移它的转录；在同一个对话里切换分支时，任何一条旧回复都不会丢失。

dsh-session-enhance README · 🗂️ 归档与恢复：在会话菜单里一键归档任意对话；归档行带有清晰标记、不再打扰你，需要时一键恢复。归档状态与工作区归属正交，因此已归档的对话会保留原来的位置。

- 会话菜单逐条 **归档 / 恢复**。
- **归档管理**（设置 → 对话增强 → 归档管理）：搜索、按最近更新 / 创建时间 / 名称排序、按项目筛选、单条恢复、批量恢复（全部 / 按项目 / 未分组）。
- **预览对话** —— 只读打开任意已归档对话：按回合呈现用户 / 助手 / 系统消息，工具调用与结果、Markdown、内联图片都正常显示。

dsh-session-enhance README · 🗑️ 保证物理删除：“删除”就是真的删除。插件会移除一切，然后再证明给你看：

- 先 flush + detach 正在运行的会话，释放仍持有它的 agent。
- 删除转录目录（带重试以应对 Windows 句柄延迟释放），并级联删除其子代理会话。
- 把该会话的痕迹从 `~/storages/*.json`、投影缓存、归档集合与各工作区记录里逐一清扫。
- 删除后**校验**磁盘上无任何残留；若有残留会明确告诉你。
- 为已删除 id 打**墓碑**，杜绝 stale 会话列表把幽灵复活；同 id 的全新对话仍能被正确识别。

删除确认弹窗会写清楚将失去什么（对话内容、子代理含正在运行的、各类缓存）。可删除单条，也可批量删除全部已归档对话——全部、某个项目或未分组集合。

dsh-session-enhance README · 📦 跨工作区移动 —— 直接拖拽：把会话行拖到另一个工作区分组，它的转录会**物理搬移**到该项目的文件夹。会话文件内的 `cwd` 头部会被改写（zstd 感知：头部独占第一帧、布局经过校验、失败自动回滚），投影缓存 rehome 以保住标题，陈旧 agent 被释放。拖走的若正是当前打开的对话，它会自动重开并立即可用。拖到“未分组”则只是解除归属。在同一工作区内拖动会话行还可以调整顺序。
section: 📦 跨工作区移动 —— 直接拖拽

text: dsh-session-enhance README · 🔔 对话通知：发起一个对话然后切走——当它在后台**结束**或**需要你操作**（等待审批、计划待审、等待回答）时，只要页面未聚焦就会弹出系统提示。可在基础设置里开关。
dsh-session-enhance README · 📋 复制会话 ID：会话菜单一键复制，已归档会话同样适用。

dsh-session-enhance README · 🌳 对话树：每一段对话都是一棵**树**，而不是一条线。你的每一轮提问是一个节点；任何时候重生成或修改回答，都会长出**新分支**——旧回复被完整保留而非丢弃，随时可以切回去。

- 对话视图左侧绘制一棵树的概览：按分支着色的圆点（每个点对应一轮提问）与连线；悬浮圆点可查看该轮内容，点击可跳转到该轮。
- **重新生成** —— 在任意已完成回答下方的“重新生成”按钮，从那一轮回退并重新生成。
- **修改并重新生成** —— 打开你之前任意一条消息、改写后让 DSH 从新表述继续。
- **切换分支** —— 在分叉点用 `‹ n/m ›` 控件在同一对话的不同续写间来回切换。
- 安全设计：若某个更深的分支会被危险改写，插件会拒绝执行（并隐藏按钮），绝不产生悬空或丢失内容；回答仍在流式生成时发出的分支操作会排队，结束后自动重放。

dsh-session-enhance README · 🔁 记录同步与自愈：会话索引可能因手动改文件或另一个 DSH 实例写盘而漂移：

- **同步记录** 以真实转录为权威对账记账：清理幽灵记录、把记错项目的会话移回真实项目、补录遗漏会话、清理投影缓存幽灵行并 rehome 身份。
- 启动时自动把被移动会话的缓存身份与物理头部对齐，标题不会在重启后退化成工作区名。

dsh-session-enhance README · 🧹 工作区与磁盘卫生：- 在侧栏管理工作区：选择已存在文件夹创建工作区、重命名、删除（其会话回落到“未分组”，文件保留），以及在工作区内新建会话。
- 在归档管理中删除某个项目，会一并删除该项目全部已归档对话，项目文件夹清空后也会被移除。
- 磁盘上残留的空工作区目录会被列出并可删除。

dsh-session-enhance README · ⚙️ 设置：**设置 → 对话增强** 有两个页签：
- **基础设置** —— `.dsh` 家目录（插件据此定位 `storages` / `sessions` / `attachments`，默认 `~/.dsh`，可手动选目录或恢复默认）与 **对话通知** 开关。
- **归档管理** —— 即上文归档相关的全部能力。

dsh-session-enhance README · 效果截图：设置 → 对话增强 → 基础设置。

在 设置 → 对话增强 → 归档管理 管理已归档对话：搜索、排序、按项目筛选、同步记录、恢复与删除。

在 设置 → 对话增强 → 归档管理 中预览已归档的对话。

工作区侧栏里的会话操作（归档、复制 ID、删除等）。

有分支会话的对话树：左侧轨道上每一轮提问是一个按分支着色的节点；已完成的回答可“重新生成”，历史提问可“修改并重新生成”；在分叉点用 `‹ n/m ›` 在同一对话的不同续写间切换。

后台对话结束时的系统提示。

后台对话需要你操作时的系统提示。

dsh-session-enhance README · 安装：需要可用的 DeepSeek Harness **Web** 环境（`dsh` 在 PATH、`web` profile 已初始化）以及 Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`。

```powershell
dsh-session-enhance README · 从 GitHub（最新提交）：dsh plugin --profile web add github:Tinger-X/dsh-session-enhance
dsh-session-enhance README · 从 npm（稳定版本）：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-enhance

dsh-session-enhance README · 从源码（开发）：git clone https://github.com/Tinger-X/dsh-session-enhance.git
cd dsh-session-enhance; pnpm install
dsh plugin --profile web add .

dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

重启 DSH Web 并强制刷新（Ctrl+F5）。设置中会出现「对话增强」入口。

> 对话树功能跟随开发分支推进。如果你安装的是 npm 稳定版却看不到对话树，请用上方的最新提交方式更新。

dsh-session-enhance README · 快速上手：- **浏览** —— 搜索、按工作区（或单列）分组、按最近 / 手动排序，行上直接看会话状态。
- **归档** —— 会话菜单 → *Archive*；稍后在 设置 → 对话增强 → 归档管理 里打理。
- **预览** —— 已归档聊天行上的眼睛图标。
- **删除** —— 会话菜单 → *Delete session*（一律确认）。批量：归档管理 → 分组的 *Delete all*。
- **移动** —— 把会话行拖到另一个工作区；在工作区内拖动可调整顺序。
- **复制 ID** —— 会话菜单 → *Copy ID*。
- **通知** —— 发起对话后切到别处。
- **分支** —— 打开对话：用回答下的“重新生成”或你消息上的编辑按钮来长出分支，在分叉点用 `‹ ›` 切换分支。

dsh-session-enhance README · 路线图：规划中 / 开发中的想法，不分先后：

- 打开工作区目录。
- 定时归档 —— 自动归档长期不活跃的对话。
- 在工作区会话列表中直接批量归档、批量删除。
- 对话星标 —— 将对话标星、排在工作区最前，且不参与自动归档。
- 对话分享 —— 导出 / 导入整棵对话树（`.dshse-share`），导入后可继续对话。
- 删除单个对话节点 / 分支。
- 对话树控制的深化、性能与稳定性。
- 对话内容回退（回退到对话中途，并一并回退当时改动的文件）。
- 其它让对话更顺手的相关功能。
